title: Rose Atoll coral (53588586050).jpg
author: USFWS Pacific
description: Underwater photos show the incredible diversity of the coral reef ecosystem, with innumerable different shapes and colors, at Rose Atoll Marine National Monument, Jan. 12, 2024. USFWS photos: Pete Leary In all, the tropical wonderland in the central Pacific Ocean protects about 100 species of stony corals, not to mention the 275 different reef fish that live among them.
